notice: Illustrative mapping from the AI Governance Engineer Body of Knowledge v0.4.0 (not a claim of conformity)

citation.title: AI Governance Engineering: The Thesis & Body of Knowledge

datasets.name: obligations
datasets.title: Obligation register
datasets.description: Every obligation → artefact → stack-layer row of the regulatory map, with stable ids, ISO application dates, status, system classes, patterns and review dates.

datasets.name: frameworks
datasets.title: Frameworks
datasets.description: The laws, standards, codes and control sets the regulatory map covers, with the ids of their obligation rows.

datasets.name: crosswalk
datasets.title: Topic crosswalk
datasets.description: Twelve governance topics against the clauses of the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, the NIST AI RMF and the Chinese instruments, joined to the obligation register.

datasets.name: glossary
datasets.title: Glossary
datasets.description: The canonical terms of the discipline, parsed from chapter 09, with their chapter references.

datasets.name: patterns
datasets.title: Pattern catalogue index
datasets.description: The reusable patterns of chapter 05, with their home layer, the frameworks their "Maps to" line names and the obligation rows that list them.

datasets.name: maturity
datasets.title: Maturity model
datasets.description: The five-level maturity model of chapter 07, Documented → Continuous, with its typical evidence.

datasets.name: path
datasets.title: Learning path
datasets.description: The four-stage learning path: nodes, prerequisites, internal links and external resources.

datasets.name: chapters
datasets.title: Body of Knowledge chapters
datasets.description: The chapters of the Body of Knowledge in reading order, with their part, summary and takeaways.

datasets.name: jurisdictions
datasets.title: AI laws by jurisdiction
datasets.description: The AI-specific legal landscape by jurisdiction: how binding each regime is and the instruments behind it, each dated.

datasets.name: harms
datasets.title: AI harms atlas
datasets.description: Harms by level with the failure mode, the controlling pattern, the evidence it leaves, the stack layers, the MIT AI Risk Repository taxonomy codes and real incidents.

datasets.name: cases
datasets.title: Incident cases
datasets.description: Publicly documented AI incidents written as engineering post-mortems, with the control that would have caught them, the evidence it would have left and the obligations they touch.

datasets.name: contracts
datasets.title: Contract clauses and licence families
datasets.description: The AI vendor-contract clauses to check (what each governs, the red flag, a fallback and the evidence to keep) and the model-licence families.

datasets.name: roles
datasets.title: Value-chain roles
datasets.description: Operator roles across regimes (EU AI Act, Colorado, Texas, Korea, ISO/IEC 22989), with duties, the nearest EU AI Act role and the events that make an actor a provider.

datasets.name: threats
datasets.title: Threat bridge
datasets.description: External AI threat ids (OWASP LLM 2026, OWASP Agentic 2026, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI 100-2) mapped to the controlling patterns, example evals, obligation ids, ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A, CSA AICM domains, NIST SP 800-218A tasks and COSAiS use cases.
